questions.questionText: Which are the three main styles applied in HTML using CSS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) Inline, internal, and external.

questions.questionText: In inline styles, styles are given directly to:
options: The style attribute of the element
questions.correctAnswer: The style attribute of the element
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The style attribute of the element.

questions.questionText: In internal styles, where is the style tag declared?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) In the <head>.

questions.questionText: In external styles, how is the separate CSS file linked to the HTML file?
options: By the <style> tag in the body
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) By the <link> tag in the <head>.

questions.questionText: Which of the three HTML styling approaches is recommended?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) External style.

questions.questionText: Why are inline styles not recommended in HTML?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) They are hard to override.

questions.questionText: Internal styles are used when:
options: Critical style has to be sent whenever the HTML file is loaded
questions.correctAnswer: Critical style has to be sent whenever the HTML file is loaded
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Critical style has to be sent whenever the HTML file is loaded.

questions.questionText: External styles follow which principle?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Separation of concerns.

questions.questionText: How many styling methods in ReactJS are discussed in the summary?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Three.

questions.questionText: Which are the three ReactJS styling types listed in the summary?
options: Style objects, external CSS, and CSS modules
questions.correctAnswer: Style objects, external CSS, and CSS modules
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Style objects, external CSS, and CSS modules.

questions.questionText: What happens in ReactJS if the style attribute is given as a string?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) It results in an error.

questions.questionText: ReactJS expects the style attribute to be:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) A JavaScript object.

questions.questionText: Which is the correct way to apply a styles object in JSX?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) style={styles}.

questions.questionText: Keys of the styles object in ReactJS must be written in:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) camelCase.

questions.questionText: Which key is correct inside a React style object?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) backgroundColor.

questions.questionText: Which style key is correct for the CSS property border-radius in a React style object?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) borderRadius.

questions.questionText: Which style key is correct for object-fit in a React style object?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) objectFit.

questions.questionText: Which case must be used in style objects?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) Camel.

questions.questionText: Inline styles are generally used in ReactJS when:
options: The style has to be changed dynamically
questions.correctAnswer: The style has to be changed dynamically
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The style has to be changed dynamically.

questions.questionText: Style objects generate which type of CSS in the DOM?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Inline CSS.

questions.questionText: Style objects generate internal CSS. This statement is:
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) False.

questions.questionText: How is an external CSS file used in a ReactJS component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) import "./App.css";.

questions.questionText: Which attribute is used in JSX to assign a CSS class from an external file?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) className.

questions.questionText: When a ReactJS app with external CSS is running in development, how are the styles added?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) As internal CSS.

questions.questionText: When a ReactJS app with external CSS is in production, how are the styles loaded?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) As an external CSS file.

questions.questionText: Which approach guarantees a unique class name for each style?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) CSS Modules.

questions.questionText: What is the benefit of CSS modules over plain external CSS?
options: The generated class name is always unique, avoiding clashes and unwanted overrides
questions.correctAnswer: The generated class name is always unique, avoiding clashes and unwanted overrides
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) The generated class name is always unique, avoiding clashes and unwanted overrides.

questions.questionText: How are CSS module styles imported in a ReactJS component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) import styles from "./App.module.css".

questions.questionText: How is a class applied from a CSS module?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) className={styles["profile-pic"]}.

questions.questionText: Which of the following always provides unique CSS classes?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) CSS Modules.

questions.questionText: Which website is used to add external fonts in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) fonts.google.com.

questions.questionText: Where are Google font <link> tags pasted in a ReactJS (create-react-app) project?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) public/index.html under the <head> tag.

questions.questionText: Under which tag are fonts added?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) <head>.

questions.questionText: After adding the font link, how is the font used in CSS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) font-family: 'Roboto', sans-serif;.

questions.questionText: Which library is used to add icons in the session?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) react-bootstrap-icons.

questions.questionText: Which command installs the icons library?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) npm i react-bootstrap-icons.

questions.questionText: How are Bootstrap icons used in a component?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Imported as components, such as <Instagram />.

questions.questionText: Which of the following correctly imports icons?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) import { Instagram, Twitter } from "react-bootstrap-icons";.

questions.questionText: Which style approach is always recommended according to the summary?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) External CSS.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is the preferred way of styling?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) External styling.

questions.questionText: Which CSS property is used with height and width equal to create a perfect circle image?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) border-radius: 50%.

questions.questionText: In the session's inline style example, which property zooms the image without stretching?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) object-fit: cover.

questions.questionText: What error message is shown when a string is passed to the style prop in ReactJS?
options: The "style" prop expects a mapping from style properties to values, not a string
questions.correctAnswer: The "style" prop expects a mapping from style properties to values, not a string
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) The "style" prop expects a mapping from style properties to values, not a string.

questions.questionText: In Code Snippet 6 for style objects, which type is the style prop value given using template syntax?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) A JavaScript object.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about CSS modules and class names in the DOM during development?
options: The class name stays the same
The class name is generated with a unique suffix
questions.correctAnswer: The class name is generated with a unique suffix
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) The class name is generated with a unique suffix.

questions.questionText: Which file contains the CSS in the plain CSS example?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is C) App.css.

questions.questionText: Why is external CSS recommended over inline in React?
options: It separates HTML and CSS code and is easier to maintain
questions.correctAnswer: It separates HTML and CSS code and is easier to maintain
questions.explanation: Correct answer is D) It separates HTML and CSS code and is easier to maintain.

questions.questionText: Which statement about fonts and React is correct?
options: Fonts cannot be used in React
Fonts can be directly added to the <head> tag in index.html
Fonts must be added in package.json
Fonts must be compiled by Babel
questions.correctAnswer: Fonts can be directly added to the <head> tag in index.html
questions.explanation: Correct answer is B) Fonts can be directly added to the <head> tag in index.html.

questions.questionText: Which of the following should be used when you worry your styles will be overridden by other styles?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) CSS modules.

questions.questionText: Which of these describes "Plain Inline Styling" in ReactJS?
questions.explanation: Correct answer is A) Using style objects.
